description: Could this business name conflict with a federal trademark? Returns matching marks, status, classes, owner, record links, the register date, and the full results URL. Optional filters can narrow or rank the search. This is a conflict screen, not legal advice and not trademark clearance. Use check_business_name instead for a complete name check.

goods_description.description: Optional goods or services; leave unset for a conflict check.

include_dead.description: Optional; include dead marks separately when true.

industry.description: Optional industry phrase; leave unset for a conflict check.

mode.description: Optional; leave unset for a conflict check. A set value narrows the match mode.

name.description: The business, LLC, or trademark name from the conversation. An LLC designator is optional.

nice_classes.description: Optional Nice classes for the goods or services; leave unset for a conflict check.

owner.description: Optional owner filter; leave unset for a conflict check.

status.description: Optional status scope; leave unset for a conflict check of live and pending marks.

name: check_trademark_conflicts
title: Search federal trademarks
